title: Steam Farmer
description: Will <positive>turn grass into farmland</positive> around itself, <positive>hydrate soil</positive> when provided with water, <positive>plant crops</positive> when provided with seeds and <positive>harvest all the crops</positive> if there's enough output room for everything that could be harvested from plants (e.g. for wheat you need 2 output slots: one for seeds and one for wheat itself)
